paper_title: RLHF Workflow From Reward Modeling to Online RLHF
caption: The training record of reward modeling. From the left to right, we present the records of training loss, gradient norm, and the learning rate, respectively.
model_annotation: This plot illustrates the learning rate of a reward model over training steps. The x-axis represents training steps, ranging from 0 to 1400 with tick labels spaced at intervals of 200, employing a linear scale. The y-axis represents the learning rate, displayed on a logarithmic scale ranging from approximately 0 to 2.0, with tick labels spaced at intervals of 0.25. A single blue line depicts the learning rate, which begins at approximately 2.0 and decreases steadily towards 0 over the course of the training steps, reaching a value of approximately 0.7 at 1100 training steps and 0 at 1400 training steps.
